Title: Initial load
Steps:
1. Navigate to https://playground.qatools.dev/.
2. Dismiss the welcome tour and update banner.
3. Monitor console and network.
Expected Result:
Step 1: The Test Automation Playground title, update banner, header, hero, practice-app cards, footer, and welcome tour are displayed.
Step 2: Both overlays disappear without overlapping core page content.
Step 3: No unexpected JavaScript or resource failure occurs.

Title: Hero Shop navigation
Steps: 1. Click Open the Shop app.
Expected Result: Step 1: The page opens /qashop/products.

Title: Hero Clinic navigation
Steps: 1. Click Open the Clinic app.
Expected Result: Step 1: The page opens /clinic.

Title: Hero Bank navigation
Steps: 1. Click Banking app Preview.
Expected Result: Step 1: The page opens /bank.

Title: Widgets navigation
Steps: 1. Open Widgets from the hero or primary navigation.
Expected Result: Step 1: The page opens /widgets.

Title: Practice-card navigation
Steps: 1. Open Shop, Clinic, Bank, Widgets, API, Locator Game, Learn, Patterns, Challenges, Test cases, and Quiz cards.
Expected Result:
Step 1: Every card opens the matching destination.
Step 1: External Pro links open only when explicitly selected.

Title: Banner and feedback
Steps: 1. Switch announcements, dismiss the banner, open feedback, submit/close, and reopen.
Expected Result:
Step 1: Announcement selection and dismissal work.
Step 1: Feedback validation and close/reopen behavior remain stable.

Title: Mobile keyboard and history
Steps: 1. Test 390x844, 768x1024, and 1280x800; use Tab, Enter, Space, Back, and Forward.
Expected Result:
Step 1: There is no horizontal overflow.
Step 1: Focus is visible and navigation history restores routes.

Title: Catalog load
Steps: 1. Navigate to /qashop/products.
Expected Result:
Step 1: Search, category, maximum price, sort, stock checkbox, product cards, and pagination are visible.
Step 1: Running Shoes is marked out of stock.

Title: Search valid/blank/no-match
Steps: 1. Search for Wireless, blank/whitespace, and xyz-no-product.
Expected Result:
Step 1: Matching cards appear for valid text.
Step 1: Blank/whitespace is neutral.
Step 1: No-match has a clear empty state or no cards.

Steps: 1. Enter !@#$, 500 characters, and HTML-like text.
Expected Result:
Step 1: No script executes.
Step 1: No markup is interpreted.
Step 1: The UI remains usable.

Title: Category links and filter
Steps: 1. Open All, Electronics, Clothing, Books, Home, Toys, and Sports.
Expected Result:
Step 1: Every route filters to only the selected category.
Step 1: All restores the complete catalog.

Title: Price and sort
Steps: 1. Set price to 0, a middle value, and 200; choose every sort.
Expected Result:
Step 1: Price boundaries and sorting are deterministic.
Step 1: Combined filters remain consistent.

Title: In-stock filter
Steps: 1. Enable and disable In stock only.
Expected Result:
Step 1: Out-of-stock products are excluded while enabled.
Step 1: They return when disabled.

Title: Pagination
Steps: 1. Use Prev, Next, page numbers, refresh, and browser history.
Expected Result: Step 1: Prev/Next boundaries, active page, and direct URL state are correct.

Title: Product card controls
Steps: 1. Activate image, name, Details, wishlist heart, and Add to cart separately.
Expected Result:
Step 1: Image/name/details open the matching product.
Step 1: Wishlist/cart state updates independently.

Title: Out-of-stock add
Steps: 1. Attempt Add to cart for Running Shoes.
Expected Result: Step 1: The control remains disabled and no cart item is added.

Title: Duplicate cart add
Steps: 1. Add one in-stock product twice.
Expected Result:
Step 1: One line with quantity 2 or quantity 2 is represented.
Step 1: Totals and header count remain correct.
